---
title: "Strategies"
---

```{python}
import plotly.express as px

from _dashboard_utils import load_strategies

strategies = load_strategies()
```

## Row {height="40%"}

```{python}
#| title: "Candidates per Strategy Family"
fig = px.bar(
    strategies.sort_values("candidate_count", ascending=False),
    x="name",
    y="candidate_count",
    color="status",
    labels={"name": "family", "candidate_count": "candidates"},
)
fig.update_layout(margin=dict(l=10, r=10, t=10, b=10), legend_title_text="")
fig.show()
```

## Row {height="60%"}

```{python}
#| output: asis
for _, strategy in strategies.iterrows():
    parameter_grid = ", ".join(
        f"`{name}`: {values}" for name, values in strategy["parameter_grid"].items()
    )
    description = strategy["description"] or "_No description available._"

    print(f"""
::: {{.card title="{strategy['name']}"}}

**Status:** {strategy['status']} &nbsp;&nbsp; **Enabled:** {strategy['enabled']} &nbsp;&nbsp;
**Candidates:** {strategy['candidate_count']} &nbsp;&nbsp; **Validated:** {strategy['validated_count']}

{description}

Parameter grid — {parameter_grid}

:::
""")
```
